Coverage_Description: Hospital & Surgical benefits (100% reimbursement) with overall annual limit HK$1,200,000 (Plan 1) / HK$2,000,000 (Plan 2); optional Clinical, Dental and Maternity benefits
pricing: Annual premium per insured member (HK$), by attained age 0-64: Hospital & Surgical Plan 1 9,462-30,570, Plan 2 10,964-36; Clinical Plan 1 5,111-12,519, Plan 2 6,955-14,969
customer requirement: Companies with >=3 employees; insured members must be Hong Kong residents
price structure: Age-banded annual premium per insured member by Plan 1/2 and coverage type; non-annual payment uses fixed factors
additional informations: Underwriting: 3-9 insured employees require evidence of insurability, 10+ no underwriting; conversion privilege for groups with 20+ insured employees; yearly renewable with no guaranteed renewal
